title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): app-page related lists bound by parentDataSource run their authored actions
body:
Fixes #12870
Clause-②: no (measured: no published export, prop or type member changes; `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` and `pageRecordActionsValue` are module-internal to `@object-ui/app-shell`, absent from its package entry)

## What changes

On a custom `app` page, a `record:related_list` whose parent is bound through `parentDataSource` now draws its authored toolbar and row `actions` and runs them through the record page's related-list executor. Before this, the page's record navigator answered `resolve` with an empty handler set, so the list drew its rows and dropped every authored action without a word.

- **`PageView` mounts the record page's `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`** inside the page's own action runtime (`ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`), so the bridge's `runRowAction` dispatches through the page's `ActionRunner`. A new optional `serve` prop lets the page publish its own value over the bridge's, which keeps the page's `recordHref` / `openRecord` / `listHref` / `openList` exactly as they were. No second executor exists.
- **`pageRecordActionsValue` takes the bridge as a fifth argument, `related`.** Its `resolve` serves the bridge's `onToolbarAction` / `onRowAction` to a list whose `parentId` is set, which means a list that resolved its parent. Every other list still gets the empty handler set. Only the two executors are served: New, Edit, Delete, row click, "View all" and the child object's default actions would change what a page list that authors no `actions` draws, and the ruling keeps that list unchanged.
- **`parentFromList` on the bridge** places `record_related` row actions per list on such a page, because a bound list sits inside its parent record exactly as a record-page list does. Absent (the record page), the mount's `parentRecordId` decides, as before.
- **A visible notice for unserved actions.** When a list authors actions that resolved and were placed but no executor can run them, `record:related_list` names them in a `role="status"` notice (`record-related-list-actions-unserved`) beside the existing refusal notice. With no parent in scope it points at `parentDataSource`; otherwise it says no host offers an executor. It has the refusal notice's audience (dev builds, or a viewer holding `manage_metadata`, the objectui#11768 rule).

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1.** The handlers that serve an authored action need the child object (from `objects`), the app segment (from the page path) and whether a parent record is in scope. The bound parent supplies the last one through `parentId`. The rest of the record page's parent context (`parentRecord`, `parentObjectFields`, the `?from=` trail) feeds only New's create predicates and row navigation, which the page does not serve. One difference from the record page: the record page dispatches through `RecordDetailView`'s own `ActionProvider`, while the page dispatches through `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`, the object list's runtime. The bridge hands both the same def (`objectName`, `recordId`, `params._rowRecord`, the shape `ObjectGrid.onActionDef` uses).
- **A2.** Clause-② no, measured: `RelatedRecordActionsValue` and `RelatedRecordHandlers` are unchanged, and the two changed app-shell symbols are not exported from the package entry.

## Tests (at `e1121c08a5`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.relatedListActions-12870.test.tsx` mounts the real `PageView`, the real console action runtime, the page renderer, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s registration and the real `RelatedList`. (a) A `sys_member` list bound to `sys_organization` with `actions: ['invite_user', 'change_role', 'remove']` draws the `invite_user` header button and the row menu `change_role, remove`. `change_role` is `record_related`. Clicking each sends the runtime's api request: `/api/v1/members/m-1/role` and `/api/v1/org/invite`. (b) With no parent in scope, it draws no action and shows the notice. (c) CONTROL: a bound list with no `actions` draws rows only, with no action, no New and no notice.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.unservedActions-12870.test.tsx` checks the notice's two wordings, a CONTROL with no `actions` (no notice), and a CONTROL with the record page's executors (actions draw, no notice). The record page's bridge path is also held by the untouched `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.recordRelated-11270.test.tsx` (green in the run below).
- **Ablation, once.** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) put `resolve: () => NO_RELATED_HANDLERS` back in `pageRecordActions.ts`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `ee051d0ce0f6` to `42c6cf7c9144`. Pin (a) went red (`Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`), and the (b) and (c) cases stayed green. It was restored to blob `ee051d0ce0f6`, equal to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty. No build was needed: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is vitest-aliased to `src`, and the mutated file is the test's own package source.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/plugin-detail/` gave `Test Files 287 passed | 1 skipped (288)` and `Tests 2713 passed | 18 skipped (2731)`.
- app-shell, narrowed: the 31 test files in app-shell and apps/console whose source names `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`, `pageRecordActions` or `PageView` (`git grep -l`) gave `Test Files 31 passed (31)` and `Tests 244 passed (244)`. The full `packages/app-shell/` directory is declared to CI. At `--maxWorkers=1` the plugin-detail directory alone held the lock for 25 minutes.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (the latter includes `tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0, after the dependency closure build exited 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 6 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 0 errors. The file count is from `--format json`, and every warning is a pre-existing `no-explicit-any` or `only-export-components`. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- The pre-tsc battery (`check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`), `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations` all exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The notice copy is English, like the sibling refusal notice and the block's other authoring diagnostics. No language-pack key was added.
- `PageView.tsx` was edited: the bridge mount replaces the bare provider. It was named in the claim's serial-constraint scan, but not in the file surface.
- Out of this card, as ruled: `element:repeater` and `list-view` on app pages, and the decision-box questions on objectstack-ai/cloud#2774.
